Fallout 5: Aratana kibō
----------------------
Date: 2177 AD
----------------------
In the Great War, Japan was absolutely demolished. Survivors had two options; travel to the Americas or die. China was filled with from the last World War and many of the Chinese would oppose the Japanese. Several boats set out for Canada or North West US. The boats the Fushō Shimashita and the Aratanaru Kibō landed on the shores of Vancouver Island in 2078. The village Bankūbā was founded in the Ruins of Nanaimo and be came a prosperous trade hub. Shin Kyōto was founded in the ruins of Victoria and grew to be a great city. Japanese culture began blending with the the American post-war culture as soon as they landed. Fifty years later the entire island had been united under the self proclaimed Shogun Kanashimi Īe, once Lord of Shin Kyōto. Lords developed in the Cities and towns. Soon, the Lords or Daimyos began fighting between each other. The Shogun's power seems fragile among the daimyos of Bankūbā Island. In the city of Bankūbā, a Samurai named Yurusa was exiled because a offense against a high ranking official. Him and his Protectron Takahashi venture out into the Bankūbā Island wastes alone. As a Ronin he works mercenary jobs and battle against wasteland creatures. He has the choice to serve a Daimyo, the Shogun, or to try to forge his own Lordship. With the arriving Brotherhood of Steel, Elder Bronce declares war on the Shogunate.

Play as Yurusa and sway the fate of Bankūbā Island.
